name: President of Turkmenistan (Office)
description: Head of state and head of government; also de facto chairman of the Cabinet of Ministers and Supreme Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces.

name: Cabinet of Ministers of Turkmenistan
description: Chief executive body of Turkmenistan, appointed by the President. Includes deputy chairmen overseeing key sectors and all national ministers. Head of the Türkmengaz state concern holds ministerial rank (Minister of State).

key_people.title: First Deputy Chairman / Deputy Chairman for Foreign Affairs
key_people.name: Rashid Meredov

name: Assembly of Turkmenistan (Mejlis)
description: Unicameral national legislature; 125 members elected for five-year terms in single-seat constituencies. Sole chamber since January 2023 (previously lower house of the National Council).

name: Halk Maslahaty (People's Council of Turkmenistan)
description: Supreme representative body. Between 2021 and January 2023 it was the upper chamber of parliament; since 2023 reconstituted as an independent representative body outside the legislature.

name: Supreme Court of Turkmenistan
description: Highest judicial body of Turkmenistan; judicial authority is vested in the Supreme Court and other courts provided by law. Chairman appointment requires Mejlis consideration on the President's recommendation.

name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan
description: Ministry responsible for foreign policy, promotion of the country's neutral status and foreign economic relations; accredits foreign media correspondents.

name: Ministry of Internal Affairs of Turkmenistan
description: Ministry responsible for police and internal order; oversees Internal Troops.

name: Ministry of Defense of Turkmenistan
description: Executive body implementing defense policy; founded in January 1992 with assistance of the Russian Armed Forces. Publisher of the Milli Gosun national army newspaper.

name: Ministry of Justice of Turkmenistan
description: Central coordinating authority for the judicial system; founder of the Adalat newspaper. Minister appointed/dismissed by the President with Mejlis consent.

name: Ministry of Finance and Economics of Turkmenistan
description: Ministry responsible for state budget, finance and economic policy; hosts the State Agency for Protection from Economic Risks.

name: Ministry of Education of Turkmenistan
description: Ministry responsible for the national education system; publishes the Mugallymlar Gazeti (Pedagogical Newspaper) and Güneş magazine.

name: Ministry of Healthcare and Medical Industry of Turkmenistan
aliases: Türkmenistanyň Saglygy goraýyş we derman senagaty ministrligi
description: Ministry responsible for public health and the medical industry; publishes Saglyk magazine.

key_people.title: Minister of Healthcare and Medical Industry
key_people.name: Myratberdi Gaýypow

name: Ministry of Energy of Turkmenistan
description: Cabinet ministry responsible for the energy sector and electricity generation.

name: Ministry of Agriculture of Turkmenistan
aliases: Ministry of Agriculture and Environmental Protection
description: Ministry responsible for agriculture and environmental protection; publishes Bereketli Toprak weekly.

name: Ministry of Trade and Foreign Economic Relations of Turkmenistan
description: Ministry responsible for domestic and foreign trade; publishes Biznes Reklama.

key_people.title: Minister of Trade and Foreign Economic Relations
key_people.name: Nazar Agahanow

name: Ministry of Communications of Turkmenistan
description: Ministry responsible for telecommunications, post and digital development; oversees state telecom operators and .tm domain infrastructure.

name: Ministry of Culture of Turkmenistan
description: Ministry responsible for cultural affairs; publishes Edebiyat we Sungat weekly.

name: Ministry of National Security of Turkmenistan
description: Ministry responsible for state security and intelligence; commands the State Border Service and the Turkmen National Security Institute.

name: Ministry of Textile Industry of Turkmenistan
description: Ministry responsible for the textile sector; operates Ruhabat, Geokdepe, Turkmenbashi and Bayramali textile complexes and the Turkmendokma foreign trade enterprise; sews military uniforms for the Ministry of Defense.

name: Ministry of Railway Transport of Turkmenistan
description: Ministry responsible for the national railway network; its agency publishes the weekly Türkmeniň Ýüpek Ýoly (Silk Road) newspaper.

name: State Migration Service of Turkmenistan
description: State service responsible for migration control, visas, citizenship and registration of foreign nationals.

name: State Customs Service of Turkmenistan
description: State service responsible for customs control at the borders.

name: Prosecutor General's Office of Turkmenistan
description: Office of the Prosecutor General; the Prosecutor General is appointed with Mejlis consideration on the President's recommendation.

name: Higher Control Chamber of Turkmenistan
description: Supreme state audit institution of Turkmenistan (Russian-language Wikidata label only; no English label available).

name: State Committee for Statistics of Turkmenistan
description: National statistical agency; publishes the Statistical Yearbook of Turkmenistan in Turkmen, Russian and English.

name: Türkmengaz State Concern
description: National gas company of Turkmenistan, established July 1996 by presidential decree reorganizing the former Ministry of Oil and Gas. Largest gas company in Central Asia; revenue US$4.13bn Jan-Nov 2020; opened the Kiyanly petrochemical complex in 2018. Its chairman holds ministerial rank (Minister of State).

name: Türkmennebit State Concern
description: State concern for oil exploration and production (petroleum industry), headquartered in Ashgabat.

name: Türkmenhimiya State Concern
description: State concern for the chemical industry; operates the Bereket urea plant, Garlyk potash mining complex, Maryazot and Marykarbamid plants, Garabogazkarbomid and Tejenkarbamid plants, Guwlyduz combine, Kiyanly polymer plant, the S.A. Niyazov chemical plant in Turkmenabad, the Ahalk gas-to-gasoline plant and the Türkmenturba plant.

name: Turkmenistan Airlines
description: Flag carrier and only airline of Turkmenistan; open joint-stock company headquartered in Ashgabat.

name: Türkmenhaly State Association
description: State association for carpet production and the textile industry (Russian-language label only).

name: Turkmenpochta (Turkmen Post)
description: National postal operator of Turkmenistan.

name: Altyn Asyr (TMCELL)
description: State mobile network operator of Turkmenistan (GSM/LTE), founded 2004; the country's largest telecom brand.

name: Gozle
description: Domestic internet search engine and portal company (gozle.org), founded 2021.

name: Ashgabat City Telephone System (AŞTU)
description: Ashgabat city telephone company offering IPTV services (136 channels incl. HD); reported 104,062 subscribers in 2018.

name: Turkmen Helsinki Foundation for Human Rights
description: Non-governmental organization for the promotion of human rights in Turkmenistan; founded 21 July 2003 in Varna, Bulgaria as a branch of the International Helsinki Federation for Human Rights. Operates from exile.

name: Union of Industrialists and Entrepreneurs of Turkmenistan
description: National union/association of industrialists and entrepreneurs (Russian-language label only).

name: Union of Economists of Turkmenistan
description: Professional association of economists; typed as government agency in Wikidata but operates as a union/professional body.

name: Humanitarian Association of World Turkmens
description: Cultural/humanitarian association of world Turkmens; has published the Türkmen Dünýäsi (Turkmen World) newspaper twice monthly since 1991.

name: Women's Union of Turkmenistan
description: State-backed women's organization; has published the Zenan Kalby (Woman's Heart) magazine monthly since 1931.

name: Magtymguly Youth Organization of Turkmenistan
description: Youth organization; serves as the youth wing of the Democratic Party of Turkmenistan and publishes the Nesil (Generation) newspaper three times per week.

name: Academy of Sciences of Turkmenistan
description: State body founded in 1951 responsible for the implementation of science and technology policy; includes the Institute of History and Archaeology.

name: Magtymguly Turkmen State University
description: One of the leading universities in Turkmenistan, located in the capital Ashgabat; named after poet Magtymguly Pyragy.

name: Myrat Garryyev State Medical University of Turkmenistan
description: State medical university, founded 1931; named after Myrat Garryyev.

name: International Oil and Gas University
description: Specialized university for the oil and gas sector, founded 25 May 2012.

name: Turkmen Agricultural University named after S.A. Niyazov
description: Agricultural university founded 1930, named after Saparmurat Niyazov.

name: Institute of International Relations of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
description: Diplomatic institute under the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, founded 2008.
parent_organization: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan

name: International University of Humanities and Development
description: University focusing on humanities and development studies, founded 2014.

name: State Energy Institute of Turkmenistan
description: State institute for energy-sector education, founded 1997; located in Mary region (Türkmenabat/Mary area).

name: Turkmen National Institute of World Languages named after D. Azadi
description: National institute for foreign-language education, founded 2009.

name: Turkmen State Institute of Culture
description: State institute for culture and arts education.

name: Turkmen Institute of National Economy
aliases: Turkmen State Institute of Economics and Management
description: Economics and management institute (university), founded 1980.

name: Institute of Engineering-Technical and Transport Communications of Turkmenistan
aliases: Институт инженерно-технических и транспортных коммуникаций Туркменистана
description: Engineering and transport communications institute (university), founded June 2017 (Russian-language label only).

name: Institute of History and Archaeology of the Academy of Sciences of Turkmenistan
aliases: Институт истории и археологии Академии наук Туркменистана
description: Research institute of the Academy of Sciences for history and archaeology, founded 1951 (Russian-language label only).

name: Turkmenistan State News Agency (TDH)
description: The country's only domestic news agency; state-owned. Traces origins to the Telegraph Agency of Turkmenistan opened in 1924; re-established in independent Turkmenistan in 1991; current name adopted 2014. Publishes in Turkmen, Russian and English; also operates the Turkmenistan Today portal.

name: Türkmenistan (newspaper)
description: Main Turkmen-medium state newspaper, published six times per week since 1920.

name: Neytralny Turkmenistan (newspaper)
description: Main Russian-medium state newspaper, published six days per week; founded 1924 (Soviet-era name Turkmenskaya Iskra). Its English service operates as Turkmenistan: Golden Age (turkmenistan.gov.tm).

name: Turkmenistan Television Broadcasting Center
description: State body with full control of broadcasting; operates the national television channels (Altyn Asyr, Ýaşlyk, Miras, Türkmenistan, Türkmen Owazy, Aşgabat, Türkmenistan Sport, Arkadag).

name: Altyn Asyr (TV channel)
description: Flagship national television channel (formerly TMT-1); part of the state broadcasting network that funnels government programming.

name: Azatlyk Radiosy (RFE/RL Turkmen Service)
description: Turkmen Service of Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty; exile-based independent broadcaster (azathabar.com), relies on stringer networks inside the country.

name: Chronicles of Turkmenistan
description: Foreign-based independent media outlet reporting on Turkmenistan (Vienna-based).

name: Turkmen News (turkmen.news)
description: Foreign-based independent media outlet covering Turkmenistan; formerly known as Alternative News of Turkmenistan.

name: Orient
description: Independent private information agency owned by Media Turkmen, founded 2017; domestic online outlet.

name: Infoabad
description: Independent private news outlet and internet portal; one of the few private news agencies in the country.

name: Arzuw News
description: Independent private news agency and online outlet; one of the few private news agencies in the country.

name: Turkmenportal
description: Domestic news aggregator and internet portal.

name: Turkmen Yurt TV
description: Foreign-based independent television outlet covering Turkmenistan.

name: Central Bank of Turkmenistan
description: National bank of Turkmenistan, located in the centre of Ashgabat; supervises the commercial banking sector.

name: State Bank for Foreign Economic Affairs of Turkmenistan
description: State bank handling foreign economic affairs and trade finance; one of the principal state banks.

name: Halkbank JSCB
description: Turkmen state-owned joint-stock commercial bank and financial services company, founded 1991, headquartered in Ashgabat.

name: Dayhanbank
description: State agricultural bank headquartered in Ashgabat.

name: Senagat JSCB
description: Joint-stock commercial bank headquartered in Ashgabat.

name: Türkmenbaşy Bank
description: State commercial bank headquartered in Ashgabat (Russian-language label only).

name: Prezidentbank
description: Commercial bank headquartered in Ashgabat (Russian-language label only).

name: Rysgal JSCB
description: Joint-stock commercial bank headquartered in Ashgabat.

name: State Development Bank of Turkmenistan
description: State development bank of Turkmenistan.

name: Garagum JSCB
description: Joint-stock commercial bank headquartered in Ashgabat.

name: Turkmenistanbank
description: State commercial bank headquartered in Ashgabat.

name: Turkmen-Turkish Bank JSCB
description: Turkmen-Turkish joint-stock commercial bank headquartered in Ashgabat.

name: Democratic Party of Turkmenistan
description: Ruling party since 1991; successor to the Communist Party of Turkmenistan. Founded 16 December 1991; described as authoritarian. Holds 65 of 125 Mejlis seats; publishes Galkynyş newspaper.

name: Party of Industrialists and Entrepreneurs of Turkmenistan
description: One of the three officially registered political parties; registered in 2012 under the multi-party legislation; holds 18 seats in the Mejlis.

name: Agrarian Party of Turkmenistan
description: One of the three officially registered parties, founded September 2014; agrarian/statist ideology; holds 24 seats in the Mejlis.

name: Communist Party of Turkmenistan
description: Communist party founded 1998 per Wikidata; operates in a banned/restricted status under the current regime. FLAG FOR REVIEW: legal status details not independently confirmed in this scan.

name: Republican Party of Turkmenistan
description: Liberal opposition party founded 29 May 2003; operates in exile (unregistered inside Turkmenistan).

name: Turkmen Union of Democratic Forces
description: Opposition coalition/union of democratic forces founded 2003; exile-based.

name: Armed Forces of Turkmenistan
description: National military founded 27 January 1992; comprises Ground Forces, Air Force and Air Defense Forces, Navy, and independent formations (Border Troops, Internal Troops, National Guard). Active personnel ~36,500. Organized into 5 military districts (Ahal, Balkan, Dashoguz, Lebap, Mary).

name: State Border Service of Turkmenistan
description: Paramilitary border guard service under the command of the Ministry for National Security; protects borders, combats trafficking, guards Caspian oil/gas platforms and pipelines; head is a member of the CIS Council of Border Guard Commanders.
parent_organization: Ministry of National Security of Turkmenistan

name: Türkmen Edermen Special Task Force
description: Composite special task force drawn from the armed forces and national law enforcement agencies (Ministry of Internal Affairs, State Border Service, Ministry for National Security).

name: Presidential Security Service
description: Service responsible for protection of the President; established November 1990; reports directly to the President (not part of the Ministry of Defense); composed of about 2,000 employees.

name: United Nations Regional Centre for Preventive Diplomacy for Central Asia (UNRCCA)
description: UN regional centre for preventive diplomacy in Central Asia, headquartered in Ashgabat; the only UN regional centre of its kind based in the region.

name: UNFPA Country Office in Turkmenistan
description: Country office of the United Nations Population Fund in Turkmenistan (Wikidata entity typed as organization in Turkmenistan; office operating since 1992 per Wikidata inception).

name: UNDP Country Office in Turkmenistan
description: Country office of the United Nations Development Programme in Turkmenistan, part of the UN country team listed by UNRCCA (alongside UNICEF, UNHCR, UNODC, IOM and UNFPA offices).
